name: China State Construction International Holdings Limited
summary: China State Construction International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the construction business for private and public sectors in Hong Kong, Chinese mainland, Macau, and internationally. It invests in and constructs toll roads and bridges, houses, buildings, hospitals, and schools. The company also undertakes civil engineering projects; operation of infrastructure assets; and mechanical and electrical engineering works.
